description: Timeline of BCA article mentions for an entity, newest first: article slug, title and source URL, publish date, sentiment score and bucket, mentions in the article and a context snippet. Page with offset. Use this to reconstruct how coverage evolved over time. Answers unseeded when no public article mentions the entity yet; an unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).

offset.description: Mentions to skip, for paging (default 0). meta.pageInfo.hasNextPage says whether more exist.

slug.description: Entity slug or alias (chain, project, person, ticker).

name: list_entity_mentions
